Name: StackSplitterSimple
Author: Ninicocolalaz
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Allow you to split a stack into many stack.  Let say you have 999 casks and you want to have them into stack of 100.  Put your cursor over the casks stack, hit "X", enter 100 in the input and press [enter] / click ok.  You'll now have 9 stack of 100 casks and the one that you "splitted" will be at 99.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Like any other mod![/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Why?  Just why?[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]If you use a whole bunch of mod like me, play with STVE and Frontier and Grampleton, you arrived at a point where you collect ~ 50k fruits or vegetables every two week.  Than, you do the calculation and you need like 150 barn to put the keg to manage it and you can only manage 200 in cask per years.  So, you add mods like big shed and automate and 5 basement floor for cask and now, you only need 50 barns and can handle 3.5k age wine per years.  So you add something to be able to place cask in barn and your back at needing 150 barns.  So you add a mod like "combine machines" and now you can get fully aged wine by stacking 50 casks together... and for each stack, you need to combine them and so need to do stack of 50 in your inventory... but you still need to do 500 of them : and there you go, you want to have something to split your stacks!  And now your back to a reasonable number of barns.  Does anybody need to go that far?  Hell no!  Without that, after 2 years you're already doing more money than you can spent... but you still need to do money until you start wondering if SV will handle it correctly![/color][/size]

[size=4][b]What to come[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]If the mod get some traction, I'll made some effort to have a better menu (I used the one that made sens by name and already exist, but it's not exactly what I was looking for... still work!)[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Say thanks to anyone who inspired or helped you.[/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: Custom Stack Splitter
Manifest.Description: Splits a exact custom number of items from a hovered stack into an empty slot.
